7.4.3 DTC groups
In addition to single DTC values, groups of DTCs can be configured (refer to DemGroupOfDTC), as defined by ISO 14229-1 [2] - Annex D.1. Each DTC group has its own DTC group value assigned (which must be unique to any other DTC and DTC group value). When requesting operations on DTC groups (like ClearDTC and Disable/Enable DTC), the DTCGroup is selected by the DTC value.
[SWS_Dem_01059] ⌈The DemGroupOfDTC shall represent the values of the DTC Group boundaries.⌋ Note: A group with the global boundaries 0x000100 and 0xfffe00 does not need to be configured, as the group ALL is automatically defined.
[SWS_Dem_01061] ⌈All the DTCs in the range between the dtc-code of the requested group and the next higher dtcgroup-code shall be treated as belonging to the group.⌋ Note: DTC groups are relevant for the diagnostic service ClearDiagnosticInformation (0x14, refer to Dem_ClearDTC).
[SWS_Dem_01337] ⌈The Dem shall support the predefined DTC group GroupOfAllDTCs (0xFFFFFF) within the parameter DTC of Dem_SelectDTC.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01338] ⌈The Dem shall support the predefined DTC group emission related DTCs for WWH-OBD and J1979-2 (0xFFFF33) within the parameter DTC of Dem_SelectDTC if WWH-OBD or J1979-2 is supported.⌋ Note, the DTC group ’all DTCs’ will not be configured in DemGroupOfDTC, because it has always to be provided by the Dem module DemGroupOfDTC: EcucParamConfContainerDef lowerMultiplicity = 0 upperMultiplicity = 65535 DemGroupDTCs: EcucIntegerParamDef min = 256 max = 16776959 +parameter Figure 7.9: DTC group configuration Taking into consideration that 0xFFFFFF is an unconfigurable value meaning “all DTCs group”, each of the DTCs configured for a group “X” let’s say, shall have their ids in the open interval (ID_of_group_X, ID_of_next_configured_group) e.g.: powertrain DTC group –> 0x3FFF00 DTC1 –> 0x3FFF04 DTC2 –> 0x3FFF06
